titles.english: Dropkick on My Devil!!: Apocalypse Day
titles.native: 邪神ちゃんドロップキック【世紀末編】

description:
Thanks to a successful crowdfunding campaign supported by its loyal fans, this single-episode special of Dropkick on My Devil! is being made in support of Takamori, a town located in Kumamoto Prefecture's Aso District.

Jimbocho has been turned into ruins by a flying object from outer space. Jashin-chan is guided by the stars to the south in order to defeat Yurine Hanazono, the ruler of this town where only violence rules. In Takamori-cho, a town rich in nature at the foot of the Aso Mountains, she encounters...

(Source: Crunchyroll News, edited)
